Tutorial
🚀 What is This? Your Claude Code terminal, but accessible from anywhere. One skill file. ⚙️ Requirements Mac, Ghostty, tmux, Bun, Claude Code. That's the whole list. 📦 Step by Step Zero to working in 10 steps. Copy-paste and go.
Features
🎯 Sidekicks Spawn full Claude Code sessions on demand. The core feature. ✅ Chores AI drafts, you approve. The safety net for risky actions. 🖥️ Displays Interactive terminal UIs. Never leave your terminal. 🔔 Notifications Dump raw data in, get curated items out. 🧠 Recall Memory, logs, settings. Plain text files you can read yourself. 🎉 Parties AI swarm simulations. Define games, spawn agents, watch chaos. 📂 Projects Build and serve apps from your clappie workspace. 🦸 Background One command starts everything.
Ways to Chat
💻 Terminal Displays and direct chat. Home base. ⏰ Heartbeat AI reaches out to you on a schedule. 🌐 SSH Tailscale + SSH. Access from anywhere. 💬 Messaging Telegram, Slack. Your AI in your pocket.
Integrations
🔌 Built-in Telegram, Slack, Whisper. Ready to go. 🛠️ Build Your Own Any API. Just ask Claude to build it. 🔑 OAuth Helper Token management that auto-refreshes. Set up once. 🪝 Webhooks Route incoming events to the right handler.
Misc
📋 CLI Commands clappie list is your homebase. Everything else grows from there. 🧬 CLAUDE.md The soul. Your personal instructions to the AI. 🗑️ Uninstall How to remove everything cleanly.

Dead Simple Setup

A Single Skill / Dead Simple Setup
No complex agent frameworks

It's really just a super minimal codebase that relays and piggybacks you to Claude Code from anywhere. The code is basically 1 skill.

~/clappie
clappie/
├── .claude/skills/
│ ├── your-skill/ ← build your own
│ │ ├── SKILL.md
│ │ ├── webhook.json ← webhooks to your machine
│ │ ├── oauth.json ← instant OAuth helper
│ │ └── your-skill.js ← auto-extends clappie CLI
│ ├── clappie/ ← the whole engine
│ │ ├── clapps/ ← displays, sidekicks, heartbeat…
│ │ └── clappie.js
│ ├── telegram-bot/ ← message from anywhere
│ └── [+ 3 more: slack, github, whisper]
├── recall/
│ ├── memory/ ← .txt files
│ ├── settings/ ← .txt files
│ ├── oauth/ ← token storage
│ ├── files/ ← photos, voice, video
│ ├── parties/ ← AI swarm games
│ ├── logs/ ← .txt files
│ └── profile.txt ← synthesized user profile
├── chores/
│ ├── humans/ ← prepared AI drafts, you approve
│ │ ├── reply-cto-roadmap.txt ← .txt files
│ │ └── call-dad-birthday.txt ← .txt files
│ └── bots/ ← automated heartbeat tasks
│ ├───── clean-notifications.txt ← .txt files
│ └───── system-health.txt ← .txt files
├── notifications/
│ ├── dirty/ ← raw dumps from integrations
│ │ ├── gmail-sync.txt ← .txt files
│ │ └── slack-sync.json ← technically a .txt file
│ └── clean/ ← triaged, ready to review
│ ├───── 3-new-work-chores.txt ← .txt files
│ └───── 6-auto-archived-emails.txt ← .txt files
├── projects/ ← websites, apps, anything
├── .env ← API keys (gitignored)
├── .gitignore
└── CLAUDE.md ← that's it, that's the whole thing
